_comment: Tiered example for v0.3 token savings: cheap -> mid -> strong escalation, size routing, presets and opt-in automatic follow-ups. Model ids are examples; check https://openrouter.ai/models (pick models with reliable tool calling) and set price_per_mtok from your provider's current pricing.

cheap.description: Small coder model for small, well-specified tasks. Escalates to mid when automatic escalation is on.

mid.description: Mid-size coder model for normal implement/fix/test work.

strong.description: Large reasoning model for hard tasks and the end of the escalation chain.

quick-fix.description: Small bounded fix with tests: cheap model, one automatic fix round, escalation on failure.
quick-fix.instructions: Keep the diff minimal. Do not change public APIs.

feature.description: Normal feature work on the mid model with a cheap advisory review of the diff.

explore.description: Read-only investigation or code review; edits nothing.
